courses.title: Omeprazole — acid suppression without inventing doses

lessons.title: What a PPI actually blocks
lessons.body: PPIs shut down the final common pathway of acid secretion. Educational counselling: take as labelled, watch for alarm symptoms — Materia does not publish titration numbers here.

lessons.title: Clopidogrel conversations
lessons.body: Omeprazole–clopidogrel CYP2C19 teaching is about escalating to the clinician, not inventing a switch. Confirm against current SA guidance and the labelled products.
